in_sanskrit.name: अनवी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Anavi is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘anu’ meaning new, and ‘vi’ meaning flow. Thus, Anavi can be translated to ‘the new flow’ or ‘the flow of the new’.

in_marathi.name: Anavi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anavi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anavi is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘anavam’ which means ‘graceful goddess’. In Hindu mythology, Anavi is a form of Goddess Saraswati, who is the goddess of knowledge, music, and art.
